description: The PDF/X-4 + PDF/A-2b dual claim (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): one file carries both the print-exchange identification (GTS_PDFXVersion, the /GTS_PDFX output intent with the printer's ICC profile) and the archival one (pdfaid:part 2, tagged, every font embedded). pdfa1b (PDF 1.4) and pdfa3b (embedded files) are refused with the engine's own message; encrypt stays exclusive. Check both claims afterwards with validate_pdf standard:'pdf-x-4' and veraPDF. Replace <synthetic CMYK prtr ICC, base64> with the profile of your printing condition.

blocks.text: This brochure is delivered to the printer as PDF/X-4 and kept in the archive as PDF/A-2b, without a second rendition.
